sources.title: Designing and Contextualising Probes for African Languages
sources.snippet: Nguni-XLMR-large performs best for isiXhosa and Luganda (which is also of the Bantu language family). The more focussed, linguistically oriented adaptation of Nguni-XLMR effectively enhances linguistic knowledge for a more limited set of related languages.
